name: AI Decision / Matching Engine
doctrine: AI may suggest but must not govern money, refunds, official status, submissions, fraud, privacy, or hard blockers.
AI recommendations require source confidence and evidence references.
No official application submission is triggered by AI alone.
Human/operator override is required for sensitive or high-risk decisions.
Candidate success signals are used for quality improvement, not experimentation on candidates.
Candidate and route scoring inputs must be finite numeric values from 0 through 100.
Every candidate signal and route recommendation calculation requires non-empty evidence references at the API boundary and database layer.
Recommendations without OFFICIAL_VERIFIED source confidence must require human review.
capacity_rule: Cap limits volume, not route capability.
